_about: Dispatcher settings. Edit on GitHub; the next run (every 15 min) picks them up. Each agent is one routine on one Claude account. pool 'admin' = planning and triage only (no code); 'home' agents only serve repos that carry the label home:<agent>; 'general' agents serve every other agent repo. Caps count tasks started (one build, plan, PR fix or triage pass each). Account caps add up every routine on that account.

agents.name: admin
agents.role: Administrator: plans plan issues, sizes new issues; never writes code

agents.name: claude-1
agents.role: Fenced repos (trading app): every build and fix there

codex.role: Reviews every PR; takes over PRs an agent could not fix

antigravity.role: ui / visual tasks, worked on your Mac
